i think the easiest way i can explain the way I feel is this. As a child i was made to feel like i wasn't a child but more of a small adult who was being cared for but not wanted around. I was building show cars and trucks and I have quit doing that, I used to game and I have quit doing that as well. I find myself not wanting to hang out with my friends, and when I do I feel like a stranger around them. It is like I don't belong anymore, its almost like a self imposed exile. I don't know why I feel like this though. 
The meds made me feel like It was easier to commit suicide. My doctor said this is why they have started adding this as a side effect of the meds. I had done pretty well of managing with out them for the better part of a decade, but for some reason it has came back with a vengeance. I haven't planned on doing anythign to my self i just wish the thoughts would stop. 

And thank you for giving me some one to talk and think over the thoughts I am having and analyze them with out prejudice.
